critic.fix_suggestion: Apply a rotation transform to the wing primitives along their local Y-axis (longitudinal axis) to achieve a 35-degree rearward sweep relative to the fuselage centerline. Simultaneously, scale the outer third of the wingtip primitive by a factor of 0.7 on the X-axis and rotate it 5 degrees upward on the Z-axis to create a tapered, canted tip geometry.

discrepancies.observed: Two engines visible under the wing
Wings are nearly perpendicular to the fuselage
discrepancies.reference: Significant rearward sweep of the wings
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: rotate wing primitives backward along the longitudinal axis

discrepancies.observed: Engines appear attached near the wing root
discrepancies.reference: Engines mounted further outboard on pylons
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: move engine primitives outward away from fuselage

discrepancies.reference: Tapered tips with slight upward cant
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: taper width of wingtip primitive and rotate slightly upward
